title: How to Determine if Your Ductwork Needs Repair
desc: Interested in knowing how you can determine whether or not your ductwork needs repair? Find out more from the experts at Rosenberg!

blocks.text: If you’re experiencing issues such as suddenly higher energy bills and uneven temperatures in your home, you might believe that your HVAC system is to blame. However, it’s also possible that your ductwork needs repairs. The greater San Antonio area can turn to the HVAC experts at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air to figure out and resolve the problem. Keep in mind that the faster you get a repair or replacement, the more money you can save.
What Signs Indicate Necessary Ductwork Repair?

Let’s say your home is experiencing issues with ductwork but you erroneously believe it’s your furnace’s fault. While installing a new HVAC system will provide a wide number of benefits, it won’t be able to do its best work if your ductwork still needs repairs. Therefore, always have a professional inspect your ductwork before making an expensive HVAC purchase. Please note that almost all the following signs can be caused by multiple things. That is why it’s so vital to turn to an expert.
1. Poor Indoor Air Quality

If you’ve got more allergens, dust and other pollutants in your San Antonio home than usual, it could be attributed to needing a new air filter. However, if you’ve already changed your air filter and haven’t noticed an increase in air quality, then it’s very possible you’ve got damaged ductwork. Once an area of ductwork becomes compromised, it allows pollutants to more freely enter your home. Sadly, this can lead to respiratory or allergy problems.
2. Increased Growth of Mold and Mildew

Mold and mildew can grow inside your ductwork due to the formation of condensation. This process happens when you’ve got poorly insulated or damaged ducts. Unfortunately, a damaged duct also makes it easier for spores to enter your indoor air supply. Being unaware of the problem can make you suffer from mold exposure. Symptoms include:

If you or a family member have started experiencing these symptoms, reach out to a professional HVAC company and have them check your ductwork. Don’t delay, either, as long-term mold exposure can also cause serious lung issues and mold toxicity. Other symptoms include chronic sinusitis, breathing disorders and cognitive issues.
3. Inconsistent Temperatures

Having a blocked or leaky duct can erode your indoor comfort. Some rooms will be cooler, while others will be warmer. This could cost you more money from trying to even out the temperature. The only way to truly take care of the problem is by getting your ducts repaired, though.
4. Pest Infestations

Your San Antonio HVAC system may become a breeding ground for all sorts of insects and rodents. While this seems like an HVAC issue, it could actually be related to gaps or holes in your ductwork. This is more serious than a simple pest infestation, though, as it can also cause:

It’s also critical to note that pests can chew through your ductwork, which will make the situation even worse. Sealing the entry points around your home’s foundation and in your ductwork are the only ways to keep this problem from happening again.
5. Increased Energy Bills

As air escapes through ductwork leaks, it forces your HVAC unit to work much harder. For instance, achieving the desired temperature will take a lot longer. As a result, you’ll have higher costs and energy consumption. Not only is this bad for your pocketbook, but it’s also not environmentally friendly. Repairing your ductwork quickly is the only way to get your energy consumption back under control.
6. Reduced HVAC Unit Lifespan

In addition to higher energy bills, you’ll also face a reduction in your HVAC unit’s lifespan. This is due to your leaky ducts putting an increased strain on your HVAC system. Signs include HVAC components wearing out more quickly, which may lead to more costly repairs and a shortened lifespan. Therefore, if you value your HVAC system and want to get the most out of it, be sure you have your ductwork checked right away.
7. Noise Issues

Have you noticed an increase in odd noises when your HVAC system is running? Loose connections or cracks in your ductwork can cause rattling, banging or whistling sounds. Unless your ductwork is taken care of, these noises can prevent you from getting a good night’s sleep. This is more dangerous than it sounds, as a lack of sleep can cause several noteworthy symptoms, including:
Having untreated noise issues in your house can make you more prone to arguments, as well, which isn’t good for your personal or working relationships.
8. Poor Airflow

As your San Antonio ducts begin to break down, you’ll most likely experience a reduction in airflow throughout your home. This forces your HVAC unit to work harder than normal, and it can also leave you feeling quite uncomfortable. By getting your ductwork repaired or replaced, you’ll enhance your home’s comfort and restore proper airflow efficiency.
Important Things to Know About Ductwork

Before moving forward with an HVAC upgrade, it’s vital to take the time to conduct a thorough inspection of your ductwork. An HVAC professional is best suited to this process. If you’ve got any signs of insulation inefficiency, leaks or wear, it’s a good idea to consider upgrading your ductwork too.

It’s also possible that your ductwork and new AC unit aren’t compatible with each other. At the very least, this will require repairs, but it’s probably best to replace your ductwork. Keep in mind that getting your ductwork professionally taken care of offers long-term energy efficiency improvements. So, even though the upfront cost might seem like a lot, you’ll probably save enough money in the long run to make it more than worthwhile.
What Does a Properly Functional Duct Provide?

Your ductwork is a vital part of your home and HVAC system. When it’s working properly, it will deliver clean and fresh air, maximize your airflow, reduce air leakage and optimize your energy efficiency.
